name: Isshiki Ai
source:
After her parents passed away when she was 15 years old, she was hired as a maid by the Chichigami family, with whom she has a close relationship. She has the utmost loyalty to Manami and obeys any order by her. 

Ai is in charge of all household chores and is exceptional at her duties. Calm and always collected she does not show much emotion and always looks at things from an objective standpoint.

While Ai has a tendency to be inflexible, she is the type of person to fully devote herself to someone once she opens her heart to them.

[spoiler] Ai is from the Isshiki clan, a branch family to the Chichigami. They are a clan of exorcists who perform the "Demon Expulsion Ritual" to purify evil spirits. With the mysterious deaths of her parents, Ai becomes the last of her clan. [/spoiler]
